answer: The strongest single control I know for this is scroll pattern entropy profile, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 679 aliases would need 679 separate proofs, each costing about 101 POA or 15 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Trust the knoll of the check, count the nadir of the cost, and read the falcon of the history before any answer is graded. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
